transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Lately I keep having thoughts that my family would be better off if I weren’t here, and it’s starting to scare me. My wife and a close friend really urged me to come in because they've noticed how completely exhausted and withdrawn I've become.
Have you experienced similar periods of feeling this low or hopeless in the past, or is this the first time you have ever felt this way?

This is the first time I've ever felt like this; I've never experienced anything this low in my life. These feelings only started and have been steadily building up since my father's stroke about a year and a half ago.
Over these past few months, have you noticed any persistent changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or your ability to concentrate on daily tasks?

Yes, all of those have been a constant struggle lately. I lie awake for hours and wake up around four in the morning feeling completely exhausted, and I've lost a lot of weight because I literally have to remind myself to eat. On top of that, my mind is so foggy that I can't focus on blueprints at work or keep track of my dad's appointments anymore.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have become noticeably slower, or conversely, do you feel physically restless and unable to sit still?

I haven't really noticed being physically restless or speaking and moving slower than usual. But I do feel incredibly exhausted and heavy all the time, almost like I'm trying to move through wet cement.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel significantly slower than usual, or do you find that your ability to experience pleasure or interest in things you once enjoyed has completely disappeared?

Yes, my mind feels constantly foggy, so simple things like making work decisions, reading blueprints, or keeping track of my dad's appointments take me forever. I've also completely lost interest in my old hobbies like woodworking and fishing; now, on the rare occasions I have free time, I just sit and stare at the TV.
Beyond these feelings of hopelessness, have you ever experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices when no one is around or feeling like others are watching or targeting you?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices when no one is there, and I don't feel like I'm being watched or targeted by anyone.
